working_title: When Ecological Representations Stop Travelling: State, Evidence, Revision, and Warning in a Task-Indexed Theory Universe
central_question: When does a scientific representation that is adequate for one ecological task cease to be reusable after capability, future grammar, structural replacement, mechanism responsibility, evidence, target, representation, or domain changes?
ownership_rule: Source repositories retain primary theorem, code, data, simulation, evidence, and manuscript ownership; theouni owns only the typed dissertation map, cross-chapter firewalls, and synthesis.

chapters.title: The Reuse Problem in Ecology
chapters.chapter_thesis: Ecology repeatedly reuses states, laws, measurements, causal conclusions, and warnings across changed scientific responsibilities; the dissertation asks when that reuse is licensed.
chapters.forbidden_inference: adequate for one ecological task => reusable for another task
required_displays: one overview DAG separating source-owned chapters from embedded firewalls
prohibited_upgrades: theouni owns source theorems
one intrinsic ecological state exists
all bridges are complete
chapters.next_action: Draft the opening ecological reuse examples and define the minimum shared notation in no more than two pages.

chapters.part: Part I — When Doing More Requires Knowing More
chapters.title: When Conservation Capacity Outgrows Conservation Knowledge
chapters.chapter_thesis: A fixed small increase in management capability can require an arbitrarily large refinement of present ecological state and monitoring resolution.
chapters.forbidden_inference: small intervention or capability gain => small required-state or monitoring burden
chapters.headline_result: For every m>=1, one new controllable action can give Delta|K*|=1 while forcing Delta K_U0=m.
prohibited_upgrades: real ecosystems generally have exponential monitoring burden
project-percentage budgeting is administratively invalid
the finite witness is an empirical frequency claim
chapters.next_action: Rewrite the chapter opening around the forbidden budgeting inference and move generic state philosophy behind the ecological paradox.

chapters.part: Part I — When Doing More Requires Knowing More
chapters.title: When Closed Simplicity Fails under Open Futures
chapters.chapter_thesis: Interfaces independently minimized under fixed closed future grammars need not remain small when the admissible future grammar is opened.
chapters.forbidden_inference: simple exact interfaces under each closed grammar => a simple exact interface under the open grammar
chapters.headline_result: The explicit family has |P_C|=2, |P_O|=2^(m+1), and K_O-K_C=m, with constrained-codebook and bounded-local sharpness support.
prohibited_upgrades: fixed-grammar minimization is novel
any new action necessarily causes exponential blow-up
CCOC proves empirical ecosystem closure failure
chapters.next_action: Draft the exact distinction between independently optimized closed interfaces and the jointly open interface before presenting the witness.

chapters.part: Part II — When Scientific Laws Fail to Travel
chapters.title: When Macro-Laws Do Not Survive Ecological Replacement
chapters.chapter_thesis: An accepted source macro-law can fail after non-nested ecological replacement, but the failure admits a source-relative exact test and a unique coarsest repair that preserves every surviving inherited merge.
chapters.forbidden_inference: an exact source macro-law => the same exact macro-law after turnover, recolonization, extinction, or rewiring
chapters.headline_result: Exact replacement transport, finite fiber-split obstruction, unique coarsest source-relative repair, transport defect, route coherence, and minimal history augmentation.
required_displays: carried partition and minimal repair figure
prohibited_upgrades: replacement relation is inferred from data
coarsest repair is a new generic bisimulation algorithm
repaired state is automatically future-, mechanism-, or evidence-sufficient
chapters.next_action: Build one complete ecological replacement example in which preserving inherited semantics changes the target repair relative to target-only minimization.

chapters.part: Part II — When Scientific Laws Fail to Travel
chapters.title: When Visible Equivalence Fails under Mechanism Uncertainty
chapters.chapter_thesis: A mechanism-independent deterministic law exists exactly when all retained response types agree; otherwise typed or set-valued reporting is the strongest honest law.
chapters.forbidden_inference: same visible state => same deterministic intervention law
chapters.headline_result: Candidate-independent law criterion, unique coarsest candidate-safe quotient, ambiguity frontier, and active discrimination under declared grammars and costs.
prohibited_upgrades: MRM identifies the true mechanism
all mechanism differences belong in ecological state
MRM inherits CED reliability guarantees
chapters.next_action: Draft the chapter around the honest-law hierarchy and use active discrimination only after the response-type obstruction is clear.

chapters.part: Part III — When More Information Does Not Give the Needed Answer
chapters.title: When Evidence Does Not License the State We Need
chapters.chapter_thesis: Evidence supports a deterministic ecological report only when the target is constant on the reliability-qualified compatible class; nominal resolution or greater information alone is insufficient.
chapters.forbidden_inference: more, finer, or nominally distinguishing information => a licensed ecological target
chapters.headline_result: Experiment-induced quotient, honest report criterion, target-safe resolution requirement, failure-domain guarantee ceilings, and adaptive false-resolution control.
prohibited_upgrades: required refinement has already been observed
more repetitions inside one failure domain prove absence
full latent-world identification is always necessary
chapters.next_action: Choose one common finite witness that carries Results 1–4 through record, target, failure, and stopping decisions.

chapters.part: Part III — When More Information Does Not Give the Needed Answer
chapters.title: When Learning the Cause and Licensing the Decision Diverge
chapters.chapter_thesis: Retaining all admissible causal programmes and selecting the next observation can efficiently reduce causal ambiguity, but causal-learning value and target-licensing value remain different objectives.
chapters.forbidden_inference: pattern fit or high causal-learning value => identified cause or licensed decision target
chapters.headline_result: N1-N4 identifiability boundaries, admissible causal sets, validated RACH-SEQ selection, and TU-2 learning/licensing orthogonality.
prohibited_upgrades: RACH selects the true mechanism
high NOV licenses the management target
the prospective Campanula case is already causal identification
chapters.next_action: Integrate the frozen benchmark and TU-2 as one argument about typed information value rather than two adjacent methods.

chapters.part: Part IV — When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
chapters.title: Which State Actually Generates Functional Loss?
chapters.chapter_thesis: Complete simulator state may be future-sufficient under a declared closure while familiar eco-genetic marginals remain insufficient for the loss-relevant transition; loss state is a target-qualified quotient, not raw model detail.
chapters.forbidden_inference: raw simulator detail or matching coarse eco-genetic marginals => the correct loss-generating state
chapters.headline_result: Declared complete-state sufficiency plus a constructive aligned/anti-aligned counterexample showing transition-level insufficiency of common coarse marginals.
prohibited_upgrades: alignment has a universal directional loss effect
the full simulator state is minimal or natural
common marginal equality guarantees dynamic equivalence
chapters.next_action: Write the warning-blind loss-state lock as the explicit handoff contract to Chapter 8.

chapters.part: Part IV — When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
chapters.title: When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
chapters.chapter_thesis: A genetic signal can reproducibly precede loss in every event trajectory yet fail completely as a predictor when it also fires in every non-event; within-state ordering and cross-state warning portability are separate claims.
chapters.forbidden_inference: signal precedes loss => the signal is a valid or portable warning
chapters.headline_result: 35/35 and 33/33 event-conditional leads coexist with 48/48 and 49/49 non-event firing, specificity zero, and AUC 0.5; warning portability remains state-conditional.
prohibited_upgrades: relative thresholds are validated predictors
within-state replication establishes universal warning
habitat labels define warning regimes
chapters.next_action: Make the full-denominator reversal the first result and move threshold trajectories behind the discrimination failure.

chapters.title: The Theory Universe: Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction of Travel
chapters.chapter_thesis: The source chapters are not one theorem but a typed universe of transport failures; a representation adequate now is reusable later only when the revised task factors through what was retained.
chapters.forbidden_inference: a representation adequate for the original task => a representation revisable for a later task
chapters.headline_result: State-only revision exists iff the revised quotient factors through the stored quotient; same-carrier revision debt measures the worst locally hidden split.
prohibited_upgrades: all source results reduce to TU-1
pairwise non-conflict proves global consistency
theouni owns source theorems
same-carrier revision solves MLTR carrier change
chapters.next_action: Draft the synthesis around bridge conditions and revision after forgetting, not a chapter-by-chapter summary.
